check_safetensors_compatible: check if a list of model filenames are safetensors compatible for a given variant
filter_model_weight_files: filter a list of repo filenames to return only model weight files by extension
get_variant_compatible_siblings: get variant-compatible model filenames and their variant counterparts from a list of filenames
load_sub_model: load a pipeline sub model component from a library using from_pretrained with device mapping
assign_components_to_devices: assign pipeline components to GPU devices based on module sizes and available device memory
